tools.description:

`repo_url` is https://github.com/<owner>/<repository> and `query` describes the change in plain
language; `branch` is accepted for compatibility, the analysis uses the history imported
from the default branch. R

tools.name: hokmah_zone_health
tools.description:
Says how well a part of an imported repository is doing and what to do about it.
`zone` is a path prefix (packages/cli/src/webhooks) or a few words ("MFA recovery codes").
Returns, from the last 12 months of history and the current code: a verdict (stable,

tools.name: hokmah_compare
tools.description:
Ranks 2 to 8 zones of an imported repository from the one that works worst to the one
that works best, with the reasons: fixes per feature, fixes per 1000 lines and tests,
over the last 12 months. Each zone is a path prefix or a few words.

tools.name: hokmah_overview
tools.description:
Overview of an imported repository: the most fragile areas (fixes per feature over 12
months), the fastest growing and the new ones, the busiest, the largest files, the most
co-changed files, and how many internal imports could be resolved.
